nl.title: Afzenders en trefwoorden toevoegen aan spamfilter
nl.excerpt: Voeg afzenders of trefwoorden toe aan de spamfilter-lijsten in DirectAdmin.
nl.bodyHtml:
Filter specifieke afzenders of woorden via blacklist/whitelist in de spamfilter-UI.

Voorbereiding

  • Concrete afzender of kenmerkende spamzin

Stappen

  1. E-mail Accounts → Spam Filter / Blacklist/Whitelist
  2. Add blacklist voor hardnekkige spam
  3. Add whitelist voor belangrijke partners
  4. Sla op en test

Controleren

  • Blacklist blokkeert sample
  • Whitelist laat partnermail door

Tip: Whitelist spaarzaam gebruiken — anders omzeil je de filter.

Let op: Te brede keywords (bijv. “factuur”) raken legitieme mail.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: spamassassin-setup.

en.title: Add senders and keywords to spam filter
en.excerpt: Configure spam filter (Pro): score/whitelist/blacklist, then test legitimate mail.
en.bodyHtml:
“Add senders and keywords to spam filter”: adjust spam filtering per mailbox or domain in DirectAdmin/Spam filter — whitelist your own domains first.

Preparation

  • DirectAdmin or Spamfilter Pro login
  • Examples of false positives and real spam

Steps

  1. Open DirectAdmin → Spamassassin / Spam Filter, or Spamfilter Pro per your product email.
  2. Do not set the threshold extremely strict in one step; note the current score.
  3. Whitelist important senders/domains; blacklist only persistent spam sources.
  4. Check the Spam/Junk folder for false positives and learn/release where available.
  5. Send a test from a legitimate external address and a known spam test (carefully).

Verify

  • Legitimate mail in Inbox
  • Spam mostly in Spam/Junk

Tip: SPF/DKIM/DMARC reduce spam better than only raising the score.

Note: Over-aggressive filtering misses invoices and password resets.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: SPF/DKIM, webmail Spam folder.
